source.publication: 2025 Oklahoma Resident Individual Income Tax Forms and Instructions (Form 511 packet)
source.section: Form 511 lines 1-14 and 18 (PDF pages 42-43); select line instructions (PDF pages 9-10); standard deduction line 10 (PDF page 10); exemptions line 11 and the Regular exemption terms (PDF pages 8 and 10); Tax Table (PDF pages 27-38); Schedule 511-A (form PDF page 45); Schedule 511-A line 6, Other Retirement Income (PDF page 17); Special exemption and Sixty-five or older (PDF page 9)

worked: Federal AGI = IRA distribution (you) 18,350.00 = 18,350.00. Federal taxable income = 18,350.00 - standard deduction 17,750.00 (15,750.00 + 1 x 2,000.00 for 65 or older) = 600.00 (federal senior deduction ignored; federal figures are given, not tested; Oklahoma starts from federal AGI). Schedule 511-A: line 6: you 18,350.00 in federal AGI, limit 10,000.00 - 0.00 on line 5 = 10,000.00, claims 10,000.00; line total 10,000.00; line 18 total subtractions 10,000.00 = 10,000.00. Form 511: line 1 federal AGI 18,350.00; line 2 subtractions 10,000.00; line 3 = 18,350.00 - 10,000.00 = 8,350.00; line 4 out-of-state income 0.00; line 5 8,350.00; line 6 additions 0.00; line 7 Oklahoma AGI 8,350.00; line 8 adjustments 0.00; line 9 8,350.00; line 10 standard deduction (single) 6,350.00; line 11 exemptions: 1 Regular + 0 Special = 1 x 1,000.00 = 1,000.00 (1 person(s) 65 or older; line 1 18,350.00 is over the 15,000.00 limit, so 0 Special); line 12 = 6,350.00 + 1,000.00 = 7,350.00; line 13 taxable income = 8,350.00 - 7,350.00 = 1,000.00; line 14 tax (the projection's brackets as numbers; the booklet prints only a table and worksheets): 0.25% x 1,000.00 = 2.5000; total 2.5000 = 2.50. Line 13 is under 100,000, so the form reads the tax table: row 1,000-1,050, column 'Single or married filing separate', PDF page 27, gives 3; expected keeps the schedule figure. Lines 15-17 credits 0.00; line 18 income tax 2.50. The test reads line 1. Line 6 brings Oklahoma AGI to 8,350.00, under 15,000.00, but the exemption is still lost.
accepted_approximations: The brackets are derived from the printed tax table and the 100,000-and-over worksheets; the booklet prints no schedule. Below 100,000 tax is figured on the exact income, where the booklet taxes each 50-dollar row at its midpoint and rounds. At 100,000 and over the single and separate worksheet starts from 4,562 where the schedule gives 4,561.50.
